Owner backend explicitly approves read of one live resource for a different active same-tenant app. No update/delete, resharing, wildcard or cross-tenant grant. Future object versions remain shared until expiry/revocation. Not a capability grant or human delegation.
Owning backend only. Repeat revocation returns 204; hidden IDs return 404. Unsupported methods return 404. Audit and revocation are atomic.

Live operator-enrolled human principal, exact issuer/subject/management-client/tenant binding. Baseline core-reader suffices; core-writer is not administrative authority. Core errors include requestId; Gateway auth errors may be HTML or JSON without requestId. Exact owner/client/origin enrollment required; duplicate client binding conflicts even after revocation. No POST retry guarantee.
